t:
That farce of the House de Grandeur and their attempts to teach something they don't know themselves. Arranging "free lessons" to "teach others manners"!

Maybe you could help me... liven up this event? Break a glass or something...

What about the fun you'll have in the process?!

Fine, I have gifts you'll appreciate. The bigger the mess you make, the happier I'll be!

You can get your reward either during the lesson by talking to me, or we'll reward you afterwards along with everyone else.
r203903.n: What will I get for this?

t: Pfft, that was pitiful. I expected more from you. I'll find something to give you, but are you sure you don't want to stay longer?
You have already received it. Help me next time – you'll get more!
Oh... Well then, come back soon!
r203908.n: No, that's quite enough, or I'll have a headache in the morning.

t: That was fun! Are you sure you've had enough? I'll give you your reward, of course, but I think there's potential for something better here.
Hahaha... Huh? What? Yes, here it is. Thanks.
Hahaha! You should've seen her face! I didn't know heroes could do that!
Pfft, you? For what? For following Cecilia's orders? Go see her, then.
What, you don't like this farce either? We are alike, you and I...
r203913.n: What, you don't like this farce either? We are alike, you and I...

t: Stay close – it's going to start soon, and I'll find a fun activity for you...
r203914.n: Stay close – it's going to start soon, and I'll find a fun activity…

r203924.n: I'll report back to the king.

t: Of course I'm fine, didn't you see me running?! The Hero of Sarnaut could barely keep up! As for my responsibilities... Yes, I got carried away, perhaps. I'll get back to work... Tonight, I think.
r203925.n: The king wanted to make sure you were fine and to remind you of your responsibilities.

t: Oh, , it's you! Sorry, I didn't recognize you. With my lifestyle, it's usually safer to run away... Why are you here?
r203926.n: I'm not going to beat you up!

t: Ugh... I can't run anymore... If you want to beat me up, do it. Just don't make me run...
r203927.n: Ugh... I can't run anymore... If you want to beat me up, do it. Just…

t:
Well, let's say... Win a hundred duels on Irene.

But pick strong opponents, not weaklings, or else you won't learn anything. You don't think defeating me will be easy, do you?

Once you have honed your skills, find me. I'll give you a fight.

Ciao!

That's quite... ambitious of you.

But if I fight everyone who wants to challenge me for the title, I'll have no time for my personal life. First prove you are really worth my time.
r203937.n: Yes! Fight me, then we'll see who is the best.

t:
If they say so, then I am.

Let me guess... You want to challenge me, too?
r203938.n: They say you're the best fencer on Irene!

t: To what do I owe the pleasure...?
r203939.n: To what do I owe the pleasure...?

t:
Oh, ! I've heard about your skills.

You wish to challenge me? Go ahead!
r203940.n: Oh, ! I've heard about your skills. You wish to challenge me? Go ahead!

t:
Done!

I believe in you: you will be able to perform the Ice Dance without any help in no time.

Done!

Now take your place in the Guiding Aura. As soon as the dancing starts, the skates will move on their own!

If you change your mind, talk to me at any time before the Dance, and I'll remove the enchantment.

The hardest thing for a beginner is to keep up with the guiding aura. I can enchant your skates so they follow it automatically. All you have to do is perform pirouettes at the right moment.

Of course, I will only rate your Grace as you perform pirouettes, and your reward will be lower than what you can earn if you follow the guiding aura properly.

If you change your mind, talk to me at any time before the Dance, and I'll remove the enchantment.

Well?

The dance starts here in the Ballroom every 15 minutes.

To participate, you need a dance partner. Many people gather in the hall before the dance. Among them are the elves of great houses and guests from other lands, like you. Invite someone.

Then wait until I give the signal.

If this is your first time here, don't worry. We made sure even inexperienced dancers can perform the Ice Dance. The guiding aura will show you where to go, and I will tell you which pirouettes you need to perform during the dance. The better your dancing, the higher His Majesty will rate your talent, and the more ecu you will earn.

It might be difficult at first, but you will master it after a few dances. If you still feel unsure, talk to me before the dancing starts. I will enchant your skates, and they will move around the room on their own - you will only need to perform pirouettes.

The ballroom is the largest room in the Galleon. Dancing requires a lot of space!

This year, thanks to a wonderful gift from the House de Blizare, we were able to organize a special event for our guests, the Great Ice Dance that I personally helped put together!

You absolutely must take part in it.
r204000.n: The ballroom is the largest room in the Galleon. Dancing requires a…

t:
You can pick a role and tell me about it: magic will take care of the rest.

If you want to join as a hunter, we will give you an Irene Deer and a magic net. Your objective is to catch as many enchanted hedgehogs with it as you can! You can catch any number of them - the hedgehogs enjoy this activity!

If you want to become prey, we will cast a spell on you that will turn you into a hedgehog. Run away from hunters - the longer you stay uncaptured, the more points you will earn! You can run for as long as you want - until you get tired or bored.

Noblemen are hunting noble beasts! Well, almost...

Our House decided to create a more accessible version of an ancient form of entertainment - horseback hunting!

Except we have deer instead of horses and enchanted Irene Hedgehogs instead of game. That's should make it easier and more exciting!

There's nothing tricky about it: just mount a deer and try to catch a hedgehog with a magic net, and if you get bored, you can become a hedgehog yourself!
A good hunt is great both for the body and mind!
r204058.n: A good hunt is great both for the body and mind!

t:
We didn't expect anything else.

Complete quests on Irene under our Patronage, and you will serve our House and increase its prestige and glory! Each completed daily quest given to you by the king and his servants will count as a quest in favor of House de Desirae. In return, your reputation with us will grow.
r204091.n: I want to accept House de Desirae Patronage

t:
You can take a vassal oath, vow to perform feats in the name of a House, and increase its prestige. The House you choose will respond. Prove that you are worthy of its patronage, and you will receive it. This will enable you to purchase very rare goods from the House.

Talk to Quartermasters of each House to know more. That's where you can take the oath of allegiance, too. You can also talk directly to the House head to take the oath. Like me, the head of House de Desirae!
r204094.n: I want to hear again about the House Patronage at the Great Ball

t: That's right. They wanted to finish what they started. But the other members didn't care for it. By then, dragons had been defeated by the Junes. It made the elves realize that the dragons weren't the immaculate, perfect example. This understanding shaped our today's society. I'm saying all this to make you see how important dragons are. Give me your permit. I'll sign it.
r204095.n: Did they want to complete the Transformation? And make the elves equal to dragons?

t: It's curious. It means, Renard gives Eurial assignments? At this stage, it looks like traditional intrigues before the Big Game. Of course, the girl must not suffer. However, I know the Cardinal. I'm sure she'll be locked up for a while, that's all. I'm curious about his minion, though.
r204098.n: Tell the king everything you know.

t: Right! Everything points to him! According to Panto and Tilbert, who wouldn’t lie, and Josephine was also telling the truth. In that case, if what Josephine said was true, then it was Sherman who lied. And if he lied, then someone did leave the port... We need to question him immediately.
r204099.n: I believe we should question Tassilon de Ardeur, the port gondolier.

t: No, I’m certain they are trying to divert our attention. I’ll need to think...
r204100.n: I believe we should question Sherman de Ardeur, the gondolier of the House de Blizare’s…

t: That’s strange, she doesn’t seem suspicious. We should look more carefully at the gondolier’s statements.
r204101.n: I believe we should question Josephine de Ardeur, the gondolier of the House de Delice’s…

t: Yes, her words are suspicious, but I think she’s just trying to confuse us. We need to keep looking...
r204102.n: I believe we should question Alice de Ardeur, the gondolier of the House de Vevre’s…

t: I disagree. I believe you are wrong. Nothing indicates he’s the one.
r204103.n: I believe we should question Tilbert de Ardeur, the gondolier of the northern districts.

t: Hmm, no. He wouldn’t lie to us. I trust him.
r204104.n: I believe we should question Panto de Ardeur, the gondolier of the palace garden.

t: Yes, I see... One of them definitely helped the person we are looking for. Did you find out who it was?
r204105.n: [Report what you heard from the gondoliers] Something is not right here.

t:
Excellent. In the meantime, Blanche and her intelligence service combed through Irene. By the looks of things, neither the artifact nor the general is here, and they haven’t been for a while. And someone is trying to conceal this fact.

What did you learn from the gondoliers?
r204106.n: All gondoliers have been informed of the decree. Everyone will comply with it.

t: That's what We like about you! Here's the scroll. Hurry! Once you learn everything, don't waste time reporting back to me. Go to Blanche right away.

You can't handle Tassilon alone, and you'll probably need help again in the future. We'll give you a magic scroll that will allow you to summon our best servants. You have already met them: Ivok, the smartest Aviak, and Potis, the strongest of them.

With their help, you can overcome his resistance. Just visit him with these two and put pressure on him: order Potis to intimidate him, and once it's working, let Ivok reassure him. This should wear him down quickly. And your silence will be the thing that will scare him most! Can you handle it?
We're happy to see the famous hero we heard so much about! Welcome to Irene, the glorious city of Ker-Is, to the royal court!
r204109.n: We're happy to see the famous hero we heard so much about! Welcome to…

t:
What are you on about?

...Ah, I know! Is this your new role? So emotional and expressive! You need to rehearse some more, and then we'll talk about our new play.
r204112.n: Tell me, what were you doing in Kobold burrows under Irene? Where is Skulnar?!

t:
Theater! What can be better than theater? You can experience the whole range of emotions! Tell me, what do you prefer? Crying, laughing, or unbridled fury?

What role would you like to play?
r204113.n: Theater! What can be better than theater? You can experience the whole…

Theater! What can be better than theater? You can experience the whole range of emotions! Tell me, what do you prefer? Crying, laughing, or unbridled fury?

Do you want to try?

Speak with me before the next act begins, and I will let you pick a role!
r204114.n: Theater! What can be better than theater? You can experience the whole…

r204116.n: I have a role for you in the next act. You just need to wait for it to…

t:
You look gorgeous as this character!

Now act!
r204117.n: You look gorgeous as this character! Now act!

Theater! What can be better than theater? You can experience the whole range of emotions! Tell me, what do you prefer? Crying, laughing, or unbridled fury?

Do you want to try?

Oh no, don't answer! I can already see you on the stage of my Theatre! When the time comes...

t:
Oh, I'm so grateful! What you do is very important for me. I need to ask you one more thing. Don't tell anyone.

I can't let anyone use this information against me, Antoinette, or Louis.
r204126.n: I had to deliver the letter for her. The messenger wants you to be extra careful.

t:
I need you to do something for me outside the palace grounds. It would be too suspicious if we left together, so we'll meet there.

Among the shards of Irene, there's one you have probably never visited before, and the gondoliers won't offer to take you there. You'll go to the gondola near the palace and ask the gondolier to take you to the Secluded Sanctuary.

Constance and I... we'll find our own way there and wait for you on the pier.
r204129.n: What do I need to do?

t:
I'm glad to hear that! I told you Eurial is capable of anything! She is a viper waiting for an opportunity to strike while everyone falls for her innocent act! A "lovely creature", a "living embodiment of the ideals of the elven race", a "goddess of beauty"... If only you knew how they praise this upstart! She's hiding something, some dark mystery of her origins, I'm sure of it!

Oh, my poor George... I hope I'll see him again soon.
r204132.n: General George Bekin is alive and will be alright.

t:
We have... discussed it with Louis.

Here, a royal decree that orders the closing of all ports on Irene. You will need to inform all the gondoliers of this.

But anyone could run an errand like this, not just the Hero of Sarnaut. Think of it as an extra precaution and a smokescreen. I’m almost certain the general has already left Irene, along with the artifact, and he’s being hunted as we speak.  You’ll have to speak with all the gondoliers and find out if anyone suspicious used their services, and if they did, ask where they went.

Some of them will probably lie. You can be sure that Panto near the palace and Tilbert in the northern districts will tell you the truth, but I’m not so sure about the others.

Hear them all out, and then use your brains to analyze their words and identify contradictions.

Return to Louis once you figure everything out.

He should have secretly left Irene. Since Renard knows everything, we have two options.

First: the artifact is still here. In that case, we need to close all ports on Irene, so we can quietly find out where it is.

Second option: my general managed to leave Irene. Then he probably has people after him, and you will have to chase them all down.
r204136.n: Where is the general with the artifact now?

t:
It’s not strange.

The world we are building will have less wars and more love. All nations will work together, and our unity will help us defeat any enemy that threatens our existence.
r204139.n: I have to say, it all sounds really strange.

t:
I’m afraid there will be no peace then.

Renard wants peace on his own terms, and Yasker is not willing to make significant sacrifices. Which means the war will flare up again.

While the cardinal is confident of his victory, it may be the beginning of the end.
r204140.n: What if the House de Ardeur wins?

t:
Since the first truce! That was when we first exchanged our prisoners - the same way it happened on Yazes. George was our prisoner back then... He was wounded and had a long recovery. I often visited him at night... And he told me a lot. Alas, soon he had to leave me.

That’s when I spoke to Antoinette. By then, she had already decided we needed a solid peace.
r204141.n: How long has this been going on?

t:
"Hello, my dear diary!

I'm Princess Daguta de Dernier. I'll write my thoughts, impressions, and other stuff in you.

Let me introduce myself. You know the name, and as for the rest... I'm a heir to my father, King Grallon, the last of Irene kings. Sadly, my mother died during the Cataclysm, which shattered the world into allods. Irene is now one of the allods, a lonely island, which is floating in deep astral."
r204149.n: "Hello, my dear diary! I'm Princess Daguta de Dernier. I'll write my…

t:
"Hello again, my diary!

I'm advised to write more about myself. Here goes. I'm pretty young, according to my people's standards. I was six when the Cataclysm happened. Now it's the twelfth year of the new era. I don't have any siblings. No family at all, except my father. He says we do have a very old next of kin on distant allods. I know nothing about him.

Irene isn't as big as I want it to be. I've learned every corner of it over these years."
r204154.n: "Hello again, my diary! I'm advised to write more about myself. Here…

t:
"Hello, my dear diary.

As I said, Irene is a pretty small allod. Ker-Is, the capital, is the only city. Years ago, we owned the whole peninsula, with a lot of cities in it: from Tir Toingire to Hay Brezal, from Mag Mell to Aiman Ablah...

It was a fairy land, well protected against any invaders with a magical wall, impassible for anyone with hostile intentions. The Cataclysm ruined almost the entire kingdom. We are the few that lived."
r204158.n: "Hello, my dear diary. As I said, Irene is a pretty small allod.…

t:
"Hello again, my diary!

I told you that we lived on a small island that was left from our kingdom. We don't have many people here. Only about a thousand elves in the entire capital Ker-Is. I think I know them all in person. How boring!

I read a lot about the past, about the tournaments, balls, and celebrations... Nothing happens nowadays. My father, the king, is still grieving.

But I'm done grieving!"
r204162.n: "Hello again, my diary! I told you that we lived on a small island…

t:
"Hey, diary, I'm back!

I need someone to complain to. I'm looking for someone worthy of me for a long while, but there isn't anyone. Irene is small. We don't have any equals, and therefore, I'm destined to die alone!

Father doesn't even want to hear about finding me an inferior husband! It's so unfair!

I'm so angry, I'm going to seduce our stable boy!"
r204166.n: "Hey, diary, I'm back! I need someone to complain to. I'm looking for…

t:
"I'm happy to see you again, my diary!

The news is, my father was super angry when he found out about that one time in stables. There was no scandal, though. But I wish there were! I could give him a piece of my mind!

In the meantime, I'm secretly dating my beloved Raul in the nearby forest. Egladien is a beautiful place with a grim history. There was a time when it was called Filthy Forest because of the trolls that lived in the thicket and made an ugly mess of it.

It was in the ancient times. Brave knights got rid of the trolls, anyway."
r204170.n: "I'm happy to see you again, my diary! The news is, my father was…

t:
"Hello, my dear diary!

I'd like to share another story of my life. There was a scandal when my father's servants stumbled upon me and Raul in the forest and reported us to father.

I'll stand my ground: since our remote allod is isolated from the rest of the world, there's nothing left for me to do but make love! Isn't pleasure the point of living for any elf? Father didn't even contradict it. He just gave up.

I'll act as I want. I'll do what I like. No one can order me around any more."
r204174.n: "Hello, my dear diary! I'd like to share another story of my life.…

t:
"I'm happy to put down a few lines in you, my dear diary.

Many things happened lately. I don't like the stable boy Raul any longer. He's too annoying, and always jealous of me when I talk with other lovely young men. There are plenty of them in the palace.

I don't want to get upset. What shall I do?"
r204178.n: "I'm happy to put down a few lines in you, my dear diary. Many things…

t:
"We meet again, dear diary!

Here's what happened: I talked to two lovely court squires, Nicolas and Michael. They're brothers, and they're very fun. We talked about a lot of funny things. I complained about the stalking boyfriend, and they promised to help me.

And you know what? They did! They went straight into his room, tied him up, put him in a big bag, and threw him into the astral from a cliff!

It's a bit too much, but I'm afraid, this is the only way out on a small allod, where everyone knows everybody. After all, how could I face him after I dumped him?

The brothers are lovely. I'll thank them... both."
r204182.n: "We meet again, dear diary! Here's what happened: I talked to two…

t:
"Long time no see, diary!

I guess I need to tell you about my life. Life is hard. I want to find someone truly worthy of me, but it's pretty hard. I met many people, I gave my love to many, but I haven't found an equal.

Unfortunately, each of them has too many cons that I can't deal with. I'm very vulnerable. If I reject someone, I can't stand the sight of him anymore. This would be a big problem if it weren't for my father's loyal servants, always willing to help. And, of course, the endless astral, always willing to accept the rejected man's body...

I continue my search."
r204186.n: "Long time no see, diary! I guess I need to tell you about my life.…

t:
"Diary! You won't believe this!

A mysterious unknown stranger has arrived at our allod for the first time in many years. He explained that he managed to find the ancient ways that lead through the astral. Amazing!

If you only knew how pretty he is! How wisely he speaks! He charmed everyone in the palace. Father allowed him to stay, although we didn't know the name of the stranger.

We exchanged a couple of words. He knows more about Irene than all of us combined!

I must earn his love! There's no other way to be!"
r204190.n: "Diary! You won't believe this! A mysterious unknown stranger has…

t:
"Oh, my diary! Woe is me!

The stranger I wrote about earlier! He's neglecting me! He's very sweet, gentle, and kind, but I simply cannot win his heart!

I don't understand what he wants. Father can't help me. Now that the Stranger brought back the old tradition of Great Balls, it's much more fun on Irene now than it was before. But still, I don't understand why he neglects me! I'm the true treasure of Irene!

It's time for us to talk! Tomorrow! Tomorrow I'll ask him directly why he doesn't like me.

I'm prepared for anything to make him mine!"
r204194.n: "Oh, my diary! Woe is me! The stranger I wrote about earlier! He's…

t:
I'm glad to see you on the side of House de Blizare!

Complete quests on Irene under our Patronage, and you will serve our House and increase its prestige and glory! Each completed daily quest given to you by the king and his servants will count as a quest in favor of House de Blizare. In return, your reputation with us will grow.
r204201.n: I want to accept House de Blizare Patronage

t:
You did the right thing by coming here.

My House is famous for our knowledge of magic. We focus the practical rather than theoretical aspects of it. Our interests lie in the field of alchemy, the queen of magical sciences. There's no waving a magic wand and shouting incantations. Only a strong mind can comprehend it. Almost all popular recipes of elven potions are developed by the specialists of our House.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are skilled mountainfolk. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Rosan de Blizare will join you. He's a talented alchemist, who will gain his combat experience with you.

Besides, we know how to synthesize the Unsteady Matter, which will come in handy if you want to reforge your armor. We'll gladly share it with you for your loyal service to our House.
r204202.n: I want to know more about House de Blizare patronage

t: I doubt anything can truly stop time! But slowing it down while you yourself become faster... That’s possible! I used to work on accelerating reactions, but they have a limit... But influencing time itself – that’s a new one...
r204203.n: Does the potion actually stop time?

t: Even though I’ve won before, I’m still nervous, . How will it go? I hope there will be no undesirable side effects.
r204204.n: Even though I’ve won before, I’m still nervous, . How will it go? I…

t:
It's a difficult choice...

Albert and Baudouin impressed me with that archer. What if we give her explosive arrows? And experiment with different compounds that can make her stronger?

Though Galleon Castle is a true miracle. It's a unique achievement.  Although... It's decided. House de Grandeur!
That’s what I was talking about. Alright, we might not win, but we didn’t lose face. I’ve already received a few orders for a few batches.
It looks like everything went well, . I’ve made quite an interesting potion, haven’t I? Just imagine the possibilities!
r204208.n: It looks like everything went well, . I’ve made quite an interesting…

t: I understand. My potions made an impression. Perhaps you'd like to do more tests? We could make you stronger and faster! Think about it when you have time.
r204211.n: I give my vote to the House de Blizare!

t: The time for alchemy will come, I'm sure. We are not only making aphrodisiacs, we are now entering completely new spheres of knowledge! Explosives, elixirs that change the essence of the one who takes them! With time, we can change the world!
r204212.n: The time for alchemy will come, I'm sure. We are not only making…

t:
You've made your choice! Celestine will take it into account when counting the votes. Whatever the result, remember that your vote is just a drop in the ocean, even if weighty.

Now go and upload the votes you've collected to Celestine.

House de Delice!

If we elect them, we will begin a new era of peace and prosperity. We will make peace with the Empire, launch joint and grandiose construction projects... We'll be united by common goals... Interpenetration of cultures will begin... What do they call it on Igsh? Convergence? Will this peace lead to something new? Or will we drift apart again? Only time will tell.

Is this your final decision?

House de Blizare!

If we elect them, we will give a powerful boost to the development of magic and alchemy. Where will these efforts lead us? Perhaps the Demon Hunters will bring about changes that will make the elves better? Turn them into something else?

Is this your final decision?

House de Vevre!

If we elect them, we will spread our cultural influence throughout Sarnaut. We will master all the new technologies of the Empire, and we will surpass and improve them. Their "motion pictures" will serve as evidence of our way of life, and gramophones will play enchanting music.

Is this your final decision?

House de Grandeur!

If we elect them, we will return to the old days when elves relied entirely on magic. Old curses and ancient spells will return. I think the elves will abandon all these technologies in favor of magic... They will walk a different path, going back to closed borders and impregnable allods, protected by the power of their Great Mages.

Is this your final decision?

House de Pluie!

If we elect them, we will enter an era of free trade. Its volume will grow every year, and our allods will become the manufacturers of the most amazing things for the rest of Sarnaut. By selling and buying, lending and holding money, we will dominate the world - not by force of arms or the power of magic, but with the help of finance...

Is this your final decision?
We are flattered, but let us remind you that this year Our House cannot be elected, therefore We advise you to choose another House.

Of course. There is no rush, but please remember that thousands of elves throughout Sarnaut are now waiting for the final vote. And not only elves, because changes in our society will affect everyone who is involved in world politics...

So which House will you support, ?

House de Ardeur!

If we elect them, we will get an era of scientific progress combined with religious fervor. A war with the Empire awaits - most likely a long but victorious one. Light will illuminate the most distant corners of this world, changing it forever!

Is this your final decision?

It is undoubtedly a difficult decision to make, !

Renard de Ardeur has done a lot. His Galleon Castle is a true miracle, the best creation of my people. Something we've worked towards and dreamed about when we saw the endless seas of the astral. He managed to accomplish everything he wanted.

Antoinette de Delice has also achieved a great deal. Her diplomatic efforts have brought the exiled children back into the fold of my people, and now she will endeavor to make a lasting and permanent peace with the Empire. But this enmity is thousands of years old. How many lives will be saved if she succeeds? But it was rightly said that every life is equally important, be it yours or that of this Orc Psionicist...

And you're about to make your own choice! As for me... It's decided. House de Delice!
r204241.n: Which House will Your Majesty support?

The new evil that has emerged recently is the demons and their cultists. Places of Power are defiled. They only birth darkness now.

And finally, the future evil - the darkness that's going to consume the whole world... Where it comes from, I don’t know. But the danger is close, very close. I can feel it.

We need to complete the final ritual. Then perhaps the spirits of the Coba Plateau will give us answers.

t:
The main difference between a cross-faction auction and a regular one is that here both the League and the Empire can see the goods and buy them from each other. Other than that, it is the same auction - a place where everyone can try to sell their items or buy something unique that can't be found anywhere else.

It's very easy to use the auction. If you decide to sell something, you will need to talk to me and fill out a special form. First you need to select the item you wish to sell. Then specify the time period, the starting bid, and the buyout price. Not setting a buyout price may improve bids! Once you filled out all the required fields, confirm the request. I will put your item up for sale immediately. Not free of charge, of course. A small auction tax is imposed on all sale proceeds.

I can also help you find something useful at the auction. There's a different request form for that. You can search by quality, level, or name. If you decide to purchase something, you can buy the item immediately if it has a buyout price. Or simply place a bid that is higher than the current bid. But remember: other buyers can outbid you at any time.

All sales proceeds and all items purchased are mailed to you. Unsold items can also be retrieved from the mailman after the action ends.

Come on, join the fun known as the Auction. It's so exciting! Like a battlefield!

Chewacca and I got tired of sitting around in Skewer, especially when they caught Caligula. Slushy Slug controls everything now, the nasty worm.

"I have a bad feeling," I said, and we bailed. Got into a jam on the way and had to run from the imperials, but then we met Ilenia and Denis who offered us this new opportunity.

They smuggle goods through Howlem these days, but there's a way to do it legally.

So we picked this place - it suits us perfectly, and now we can arrange cross-faction trading. If you need to sell anything, talk to me.

Ilenia can exchange crystals for you, and if you need a bank, Denis Zharin will help you.

t: I have recorded all your scores in trials. Which rating are you interested in?

The reward for the Two-Weeks’ Competition in the seasonal Olympics is Dionic Olympics Emblems. You can spend these emblems to purchase certain rewards from me.

Absolutely everyone will receive Emblems for participation, but the quantity depends on your position in the ranking. Players with the best results will earn special achievements and titles.

Besides the seasonal Olympics, there are also intermediate Two-Weeks’ Competitions. For two weeks, we record the best results you achieve in the trials during that time, and at the end of that period, you will receive rewards based on your accomplishments. After that, the rating will be reset, and the competition will start anew.

Don’t worry about your seasonal results - they will be stored until the end of the Olympics.

Dionic Olympics are held 4 times a year, and each season lasts 3 months.

During a season, we record your best results in trials, then add them up to calculate your total score in the Olympics.

At the end of the season, we sum up the results and reward the winners who have scored the most points in the overall Olympics rankings. Once another Olympics start, the rankings are reset, and the competition starts anew.

You will find the Olympic competition schedule in your calendar.

Winter Olympics start on December 1, and the scores are calculated on March 1.

Spring Olympics start on March 1 and end on June 1.

Summer Olympics are held from June 1 to September 1.

Fall Olympics - from September 1 to December 1.

But that’s not all!

Besides the seasonal Olympics, there are also intermediate Two-Weeks’ Competitions, where you get a separate reward depending on your score.
I will tell you everything you need to know as an Olympics participant. Ask away!
Dionic Olympics are where the true champions of Dionic Games meet!

The worm really hates it when people stomp around loudly. It test its patience.

We have a plan: if you locate the Worm, give the signal using a signal rocket! Then we'll get into our manamobiles and come to you! After that, we'll kill the bastard!

So we traveled to other allods, gathering people who wished to fight. Shamans paid for that - I don't know where they got the money. I hear the Elves were behind it.

Our doctrine was once favored by the despots who ruled Hickut, but they were as paltry as the rest. They turned away from magic, instead preferring the tricks of the Mechanics and their leader, Ur.

An inventor and crafty artisan, he gave many of his toys to the people, build new palaces and abodes, and made possible that which was once unthinkable. And he was yearning for power... For many long years I had been looking for answers, and so I have found them.

What puts the living apart from the dead, and the dead from the living, what is the essence that grants a modicum of spirit to the flawed flesh? What is the difference between the motionless rock and the running cheetah?

In order to find the answers to my questions, I had to sever the lives of many, many creatures during my studies. They were the necessary sacrifice that had to be taken for the sake of the grand purpose. Such was its fate, to become the support for the road that we would walk: I and my faithful followers.

But the source of any and all life was found: the Spark, the divine gift, the endless flame, the wellspring of energy. Each and every living creature possesses it, though it does not burn in all of them equally.

This fire kindles with time, but as the inevitable course of life runs past, it dwindles - though does not vanish altogether - petering out and becoming carried away by the great flow of magic.
